# Web API map

Every operation of LLMDyno's web API, with the Python call, the command and the JavaScript method that reach it. The dashboard uses this API; so do the Python library in [remote mode](../REMOTE.md) and the [JavaScript client](../JAVASCRIPT.md). A test fails when a route has no library call, so the four columns can't drift apart.

A running server also describes the API itself, from the same code:

- `http://127.0.0.1:8777/docs`: interactive Swagger UI, where you can try each call.
- `http://127.0.0.1:8777/redoc`: the same as a reference page.
- `http://127.0.0.1:8777/openapi.json`: the OpenAPI 3 schema, for generating other clients.

Requests from another machine need the access token, as `Authorization: Bearer TOKEN` or `?token=TOKEN` (see [Remote mode](../REMOTE.md)); without it the answer is 401. Errors come back as `{"detail": "message"}` with the HTTP status of the [library's error](errors.md): 400 invalid, 403 forbidden, 404 not found, 409 conflict or failed preflight, 428 risk not acknowledged, 429 rate limited, 502 upstream failure, 507 insufficient storage.

Besides the operations below, the server answers:

| Route | What it is |
|---|---|
| `GET /api/health` | Whether the server is up: `ok`, `version`, `schema_version`, `time` and `data_dir`. The library and the JS client call it when they connect. |
| `WS /ws` | Live events: run, plan, job and GPU updates. `llmdyno.watch()`, `dyno.watch()` and the dashboard listen here; from another machine add `?token=TOKEN`. |
